# Money Noodle Copilot entry point

Read and follow the repository root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before planning or editing. It is the current cross-harness instruction authority and routes detailed standards.

At the start of every session, run `node tools/coordination-status.mjs` and read the linked shared plan and active work claims. Do not assume an unavailable or empty-looking registry means scope is unclaimed. Follow `docs/development/parallel-work.md` for claims, worktrees, stale work, recovery planning, and cleanup.

Do not duplicate project requirements in this file; update their owning document and the root routing map instead.
